page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 24 dedicated physical cores and 24 vCPUs, meaning hyperthreading is not active with 1.0 thread per core. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear tradeoff between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested hardware. However, multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, consistently achieve average tier results. Memory bandwidth for both cached small blocks and uncached large blocks also falls into the average category.

Given its hardware profile, the instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high single-threaded compute performance. The high memory density makes it suitable for database operations, Redis caching layers, and memory-bound enterprise applications. It is also well-suited for static web serving, software compilation, and moderate multi-threaded processing tasks, while being less optimal for single-threaded execution or heavy local storage requirements.
